# Esco Pharma

> > Esco Pharma provides contamination control equipment and aseptic processing solutions for pharmaceutical manufacturing, cell therapy, and sterile compounding.

Esco Pharma specializes in ISO Class 5 cleanroom isolators, cell processing systems, and containment equipment for pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and healthcare applications. The company serves markets including sterile compounding (USP 797/800), cell therapy manufacturing, inhalation drug delivery, and defense/military applications with FDA cGMP and PIC/S compliant solutions.

## Key Topics

- ISO Class 5 cleanroom technology
- Aseptic processing and sterile compounding
- Cell Processing Isolator (CPI)
- USP 797 and USP 800 compliance
- Contamination control and containment equipment
- FDA cGMP and PIC/S standards
- Cell therapy and bioprocessing
- Primary Engineering Controls (PEC)
- Metered-dose inhalers (MDI)
- Biopharmaceutical manufacturing
- Operator protection systems
- Biodecontamination technology
- Large molecule biologics
- Pharmaceutical isolators
- Cleanroom technology

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Cell Processing Isolator (CPI) | Esco Healthcare](https://www.escopharma.com/products/cell-processing-isolator/19): Cell Processing Isolator (CPI) for ISO Class 5 aseptic cell therapy
- [Large Molecule](https://www.escopharma.com/solutions/by-application-large-molecule): Biologics/biopharmaceutical manufacturing solutions for large molecules
- [Inhalation](https://www.escopharma.com/solutions/inhalation): MDI/metered-dose inhaler equipment packages and process solutions
- [Enteral](https://www.escopharma.com/solutions/enteral): Oral solid dosage tablet formulation and manufacturing solutions
- [Military / Defense](https://www.escopharma.com/solutions/military-or-defense): Cleanroom isolators for military/defense semiconductor applications
